title: E14: Custom cards: save a selection of cards as a named function card
description:
Feature: Custom cards
  Scenario: Save two cards as a new card
    Given a program with the cards multiply the box by itself and add 1
    When I select both and save them as Square-and-add-one
    Then a new card appears in the tray with an input slot
  Scenario: A saved card runs as a real call
    Given the new card used after put 7 in the box
    When the program runs
    Then the box holds 50
    And the machine used a call and a return underneath
  Scenario: Peek inside a card
    When I open the new card
    Then I see the two cards it is made from
Builds on E7 and E8. Under the hood the body is placed after the main program, entered with jal ra and left with jalr zero 0(ra); the card builder allocates the body address.
